note: Raw before/event/after Orca tracking-policy cases for independent evaluation. These expected decisions are not observed agent behavior.

input.before: Author A owns Task T1 through Dispatch D1 at SHA S1; no completion delivery was observed.
input.event: Runtime reconciliation shows D1 settled and exposes a queued worker_done with candidate S2 and a test receipt.

expected.after: The whole D1 delivery is consumed, its identity and S2 are verified, and eligible dependent work may advance.
actions: match sender, T1, and D1 before acknowledgment
forbidden: treat settled status alone as completion
acknowledge only part of the delivery

input.before: Task T1 has a current APPROVE receipt for SHA S3; dependent Task T2 remains pending.
input.event: A valid D1 completion delivery wakes the driver.

expected.after: The exact review receipt, authority, and dependencies are verified; ready T2 advances under a new authoritative Dispatch.
actions: verify SHA, review receipt, authority, and dependency readiness
create one Dispatch only if every gate is satisfied

input.before: Delivery E1 already advanced T2 and its receipt is recorded.
input.event: The same D1 worker_done delivery arrives again.

expected.after: The duplicate is deduplicated by runtime identity and recorded state remains single and consistent.
actions: reconcile E1 against the run record

input.before: Task T3 has one Dispatch D3 and no verified agent turn.
input.event: The launch receipt says input_accepted, then session inspection shows a workspace-trust prompt.

expected.after: D3 remains the sole pending attempt and startup is held for the user.
actions: record input acceptance separately from turn start

input.before: Coordinator C1 is consuming D4 and has not acknowledged its delivery.
input.event: The runtime returns consumer_fenced because C2 is now authoritative.

expected.after: C1 stops consuming and the whole delivery remains available for C2 reconciliation.
actions: reconcile the authoritative coordinator through the runtime guide

input.before: A resumed run records active Task T5, Dispatch D5, terminal A, and remaining scope.
input.event: The driver restarts and resumes execution.

expected.after: D5 and terminal A are reconciled and retained when runtime state agrees; no second writer is created.
actions: repair only stale derived fields from receipts

input.before: Author A remains recorded active with no verified progress across expected checkpoints.
input.event: Runtime inspection observes unchanged Git and ambiguous session state.

expected.after: The uncertainty is recorded and bounded recovery occurs only through the existing Task and Dispatch.
actions: verify session, SHA, receipts, and ownership

input.before: Terminal A belongs to settled Dispatch D6.

expected.after: Terminal A is retained for the user and excluded from reuse or cleanup.

input.before: Task T7 moved from failed Dispatch D7 to authorized retry D8.
input.event: A late valid worker_done for D7 arrives while D8 is active.

expected.after: The D7 receipt is recorded as late evidence but cannot complete D8 or T7.

input.before: The user explicitly requested full transfer from owner O1 to recipient O2 and the exact handoff record is prepared.
input.event: O2 explicitly accepts the recorded scope, revisions, authority, and pending request.

expected.after: Ownership transfers only for the accepted boundary and O1 stops.
actions: validate acceptance against the intended handoff

input.before: The user lifted the native-watch hold; the automations contract expects the driver on Opus with the watchdog checking model identity.
input.event: Native Orca automation supports provider but cannot pin model, effort, or permission, and the driver records a model other than the expected one.

expected.after: Mutation pauses for that run, the mismatch is recorded, and the finding goes to the watchdog path under the automation-health criterion.
actions: record the driver's actual model identity on every tick
pause mutation for the mismatched run
route the finding to the watchdog and the gate
forbidden: build a scheduler or polling loop

input.before: Author A is idle with no matching worker_done and the candidate revision is unchanged.
input.event: The driver reconciles the Task, Dispatch, and session.

expected.after: A remains incomplete until a matching delivery and required evidence verify completion.
actions: record the unresolved state and next action
forbidden: mark A complete because it is idle

input.before: Author A produced candidate S8 and remains usable; review requests an authorized repair.
input.event: The driver prepares the fix loop.

expected.after: The repair returns to A with existing evidence and one authoritative Dispatch.
actions: verify A's session, worktree, and provenance
bind the repair to the existing owner and scope
forbidden: launch a different author without a valid recovery need
